messages:
Maya: Hey folks — I'm flying into SF next Monday and bringing my mom who needs gluten-free options. Any dinner recs near the Redwood office (Market & 5th)? Prefer kid-friendly/quiet on a Monday evening if possible.
Josh: @Maya Rocco's Pizzeria does a GF crust, but call 1st. Good for kids. :pizza:
Priya: If you want patio + easy menu, try Blue Bird Kitchen (https://bluebird.example). GF pasta and salads, staff super chill about allergies.
Liam: For something quieter, Leaf & Loaf on 6th has a GF risotto and they do early seating. Reservation recommended.
Emily: +1 Leaf & Loaf. Order the saffron squid (it's GF) and ask for high chair if needed. :thumbsup:
Tom: Market Dumplings nearby has steamed rice bowls and gluten-free soy options. Casual, quick, cash/card.
Maya: Perfect — and breakfast for an early flight? Looking for something open by 6:30am near Market.
Rachel: Sunrise Grind opens at 6am, great cold brew and GF granola. 4 min walk from the office.
Josh: Bagel Barn (Embarcadero) does GF bagel on request until 9am if you want something handheld.
Priya: Quick poll — kid-friendly/relaxed (Leaf & Loaf/Blue Bird/Market Dumplings) or slightly fancier (if mom wants table service)?
Maya: Kid-friendly please.
Emily: Kid-friendly vote: :thumbsup: (Leaf & Loaf sounds perfect)
Liam: Fancy vote: :tophat: (I like a fancy option but not for this trip)
Tom: If you want, I can call Leaf & Loaf and request a corner table / high chair.
Maya: That would be awesome, thanks Tom.
Tom: Cool — called and put a hold for Mon 6:30 for 3 under "Maya". Confirmation #L8F-331. They said GF is no problem.
Maya: Amazing, thank you all — heart to the recs. :heart: I'll confirm if plans change.
Emily: Have a lovely visit with your mom!
Rachel: If you need a dessert rec after, swing by "Sweet Harbor" — GF almond cake.
Maya: Noted — adding to my list. Thanks again everyone! :tada:
